questions.question: Which of the following numbers is prime?
questions.explanation: 51 = 3 × 17, 57 = 3 × 19 and 91 = 7 × 13 are composite. 53 has no divisor other than 1 and itself, so it is prime.

questions.question: The sum of the first 20 natural numbers is
How many prime numbers are there between 1 and 20?
questions.explanation: The primes are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17 and 19, which is 8 numbers.

questions.question: Which of the following is an irrational number?
questions.explanation: √49 = 7, 0.75 = 3/4 and 22/7 are rational. √2 cannot be written as a fraction of integers, so it is irrational.

questions.question: The unit digit of 7⁴ is
questions.explanation: 7⁴ = 2401, whose unit digit is 1.

questions.question: The smallest 3-digit perfect square is
questions.explanation: 10² = 100 is the smallest square with three digits (9² = 81 has only two).

questions.question: The unit digit of 3⁷⁴ is
questions.explanation: Unit digits of powers of 3 repeat every four steps: 3, 9, 7, 1. Since 74 ÷ 4 leaves remainder 2, the unit digit is the second one, 9.
questions.shortcut: Divide the power by 4 and use the remainder.

questions.question: The sum of the first 15 odd numbers is
questions.explanation: The sum of the first n odd numbers is n². So the sum is 15² = 225.

questions.question: The number of factors of 72 is
questions.explanation: 72 = 2³ × 3². Number of factors = (3 + 1)(2 + 1) = 12.
questions.shortcut: Add 1 to each exponent in the prime factorisation and multiply.

questions.question: What is the smallest number to be added to 1000 to make it a perfect square?
questions.explanation: 31² = 961 and 32² = 1024. The next square after 1000 is 1024, so we add 1024 − 1000 = 24.

questions.question: How many prime numbers lie between 30 and 50?
questions.explanation: The primes are 31, 37, 41, 43 and 47, which makes 5.

questions.question: The remainder when 2¹⁰ is divided by 7 is
questions.explanation: 2³ = 8 leaves remainder 1 on division by 7. So 2¹⁰ = (2³)³ × 2 leaves 1 × 2 = 2.

questions.question: The largest 4-digit number exactly divisible by 12 is
questions.explanation: 9999 ÷ 12 leaves remainder 3 (since 12 × 833 = 9996). So the number is 9999 − 3 = 9996.

questions.question: The sum of all two-digit numbers is
questions.explanation: The numbers 10 to 99 form an AP with 90 terms. Sum = 90 × (10 + 99)/2 = 90 × 54.5 = 4905.

questions.question: The unit digit of 2²⁰²³ × 3²⁰²⁴ is
questions.explanation: Powers of 2 cycle 2, 4, 8, 6. 2023 leaves remainder 3 on division by 4, giving 8. Powers of 3 cycle 3, 9, 7, 1. 2024 is divisible by 4, giving 1. Unit digit of the product is 8 × 1 = 8.

questions.question: The number of positive divisors of 360 is
The last two digits of 7¹⁰⁰ are
questions.explanation: 7⁴ = 2401, which ends in 01. So 7¹⁰⁰ = (7⁴)²⁵ ends in 01²⁵ = 01.
questions.shortcut: Look for a power ending in 01.

questions.question: The remainder when 17²³ is divided by 16 is
questions.explanation: 17 leaves remainder 1 on division by 16, so 17²³ leaves remainder 1²³ = 1.

questions.question: How many numbers between 100 and 300 are divisible by 7?
questions.explanation: The first multiple above 100 is 105 (7 × 15) and the last below 300 is 294 (7 × 42). Count = 42 − 15 + 1 = 28.

questions.question: The smallest number by which 1176 must be multiplied to make it a perfect square is
questions.explanation: 1176 = 2³ × 3 × 7². The prime powers 2³ and 3 have odd exponents, so we multiply by 2 × 3 = 6 to get 2⁴ × 3² × 7².
